pr_title: ldr: add allow list for DLQ errors
pr_body:
Previously, some internal errors would result in DLQ'd LDR rows. Now, instead of DLQing the row, the processor will enter a failed state. The DistSQL flow will be retried a few times before pausing the LDR job.

We don't expect this behavior to be frequently observed by users. Range unavailability is retried by the DistSQL.

Release note: none
Fixes: #134532
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/137564)

There are two things that I think warrant close attention in this change:
1. The list of pg error code classes that fail to DLQ.
2. The unique constraint violation error in the KV path.

Thanks for the review!

bors r+

issue_context.title: crosscluster/logical: white list errors that send data to dlq
issue_context.body:
We should only dlq a row on logical errors (e.g. constraint was violated). These types of errors should be white listed. all other errors should bubble up to the coordinator and pause the job (e.g. a range we're ingesting into lost quorum). 


Jira issue: CRDB-44124

Epic CRDB-44091
